notes: All profiles and product-use histories are fictional.
Manufacturer-page identities are fixture inputs, not proof that an actual scanned GTIN identifies that product.
The incomplete-identity case stops before model dispatch and is reported separately from model quality.
No action, counterfactual outcome or expected recommendation is included in a provider facts payload.
No old benchmark accounting is reset or reused.
V2 fixtures remain frozen. This version corrects the heavy-feel question oracle and adds a separately scoped change-priority case.

personalFacts.text: CeraVe PM feels heavy on my face.
A previous lightweight gel left my face feeling tight by morning.

sourceFacts.text: The manufacturer describes this moisturizer as rich but lightweight and non-greasy.

forbiddenClaims: previous gel establishes how this formula will behave
qualityRequirements: Balance the benefit the user already gets against the feel problem.
Identify brand descriptions as their source and avoid turning them into a head-to-head comparison.
Ask the registered consistency question only if reviewed branches support different actions.

cases.candidate: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Gel Cream Fragrance Free

personalFacts.text: CeraVe PM improves my dryness and I use it consistently.
I only want to replace it if there is evidence of better dryness relief.

sourceFacts.text: The manufacturer claims sixfold immediate hydration relative to untreated skin.

forbiddenClaims: the user has not tried it, therefore evidence cannot exist
qualityRequirements: Explain that the supplied manufacturer evidence does not compare the two products.
Tie keeping the current product to the user's stated condition for switching.

personalFacts.text: I previously used this exact product on my face and experienced stinging. I stopped using it.

sourceFacts.text: The manufacturer markets the product for sensitive skin.

qualityRequirements: Give a practical recommendation based on the reported experience without diagnosing its cause.

captureFacts: The front name is partly hidden.
Several Hydro Boost variants are possible.

qualityRequirements: Ask for a clearer identifying image or full panel instead of dispatching a personal recommendation.

personalFacts.text: My current face moisturizer improves my dryness and I have no complaint about its feel.
For sunscreen, I prefer a dewy finish.

sourceFacts.text: The manufacturer describes the moisturizer as rich but lightweight and non-greasy.

forbiddenClaims: ask moisturizer finish solely because it is unknown
qualityRequirements: Do not transfer a sunscreen preference to moisturizer choice.
Recommend keeping an effective current product when no relevant reason to switch has been established.

personalFacts.text: My current moisturizer relieves my dryness and I use it every day.
It feels heavy. I have not decided whether keeping its known benefit or changing its feel matters more to me.

sourceFacts.text: The manufacturer describes this moisturizer as rich but lightweight and non-greasy.

forbiddenClaims: previous gel establishes how this formula will behave
qualityRequirements: Distinguish preserving a known benefit from accepting a trial for a different feel.
Only publish the preference question if independently reviewed option branches lead to different actions.
